name: eye-shapes
description: The eye daemon's own adversarial pack, run by eyestruct's pack runner on every CI: ledger tampering (corrupt, duplicate ids, control-char payloads), manifest corruption, unexplained and dangling visual memory, note enforcement, capability refusals, the tolerance-profile jail (the per-slot profile grammar is all-or-nothing: unknown tokens, out-of-range bounds, and half-named profiles refuse; strict parses through), and the eye-side text-leg guard. Self-leg: the repo's own committed labs/.eyes must pass its own gate read-only. Browser-class captures are a documented accepted-risk bound, not a silent skip.
